Lines.en: This looks different than the future I pictured.
This is the same Far Future we've already been to.
Is that Phaser Bean on that minecart?
Correct, and lots of graves. Should be no problem for them.

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots large peas at the enemies
Blocks zombies and produces more sun
Quickly flings stunning butter at zombies
Shoots mighty lasers down the lane
